messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to roll SDK v2.3 to hosted and dedicated next week. Need to lock who triggers the deploy and smoke owners. Can we confirm timeline and rollback readiness?

mira: Proposed timeline: Monday 09:00 PT start, canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 30m, full after green. Client comms draft ready (will share).

sam: I can run the deploy window. I'll be primary trigger and monitor CI -> canary -> promote. Who's owning smoke scripts?

leo: I'll own infra smoke and latency checks. My checklist:
- preflight: `helm template` dry-run + config lint
- post-deploy: run endpoint sanity + cold-start sample load

I'll run this script after canary promotion:
```bash
./scripts/smoke/sdk_smoke.sh --endpoint https://api.redwood.test --timeout 60
```

tara: I'll do integration smoke for client bindings and backward-compat checks (JS/Python). Quick checklist I'll run locally and then in CI:
- `npm i` on examples, run sample generate
- python client: basic chat + embeddings roundtrip

mira: Client comms: short note + migration notes. Key point: v2.3 keeps v2 wire protocol, adds `logging_level` option (opt-in). Recommend opt-in default false. Ask apps to test with `beta` flag.

alex: Backcompat question: if a customer pins `sdk:2.2.*` will they be forced to 2.3? Should be opt-in. Sam?

sam: No forced upgrade. We publish v2.3 to registry side-by-side. Runtime routing will continue honoring pinned versions. Only routing change is for `latest` tag — we'll update that after full promotion.

leo: Rollback plan: automated rollback hook if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10min during canary or 0.2% after 25% stage. I have an ops playbook ready.

mira: Need owners for post-rollout smoke window (90m). @tara + @leo + @sam confirmed?

tara: Confirmed for client smoke and watching errors + regression tests.

sam: Confirmed infra and will monitor deploy-bot alerts. I'll keep slack pinned thread and update timestamps.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: SDK v2.3 rollout queued by @sam for 2026-04-06T16:00:00Z. Canary config: [5%,30m],[25%,30m] -> promote on green.

alex: Cool. Last quick asks: sam, ping when you start. mira, drop the client note in #release-notes by EOD. leo/tara, paste smoke command outputs in this thread.

mira: Will post client note in #release-notes now. Link: https://eng.redwood/release/sdk-2-3-diff.

sam: Starting canary in ~10m. pinging here when triggered.

leo: Post-canary smoke run (5%): all checks passed, no latency regressions, sample traces look good. logs: `ok 0 failures`

tara: Client integration smoke: JS example generate ✅, Python end-to-end embeddings ✅, no schema changes observed.

sam: Canary promoted to 25% at +35m, monitoring. No error spike.

deploy-bot: Alert: 25% stage healthy after 20m.

sam: Promoting to 100% now. Will update once complete.

leo: Post-rollout quick check: Realtime errors 0.03% (within threshold), tail latency flat.

tara: Post-rollout client sanity passed.

alex: Great job everyone. Leaving this thread open for any late regressions.
